name: cavemio-steps
title: Steps
description: Where you are in a flow: the line to the next step fills along its length, the finished number blurs into a drawn check, and phones get "Step 2 of 4".

cavemio.usage:
import { Steps } from "@/components/steps";

<Steps current={1} steps={[{ label: "Cart" }, { label: "Details" }, { label: "Payment" }, { label: "Done" }]} />
cavemio.accessibility:
- The current step has aria-current="step".
- Reduced motion: lines and checks change at once.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: current
props.description: – · Index of the current step; steps.length means all done.

props.name: onStepClick
props.description: – · Let people go back to finished steps.

states.title: advance
states.description: The line fills (520ms); the number blurs into a check (360ms draw); the next ring pops in.

states.title: back
states.description: The line drains with a slight overshoot; the number returns.

states.title: narrow
states.description: Step number rolls; the name morphs.
